beats.beat_text: Payroll bounces tomorrow because Mara hid the notice.
Mara opens the notice because Levi shows the empty total.
The partners build a review because disclosure makes planning possible.

char_levi_002.appearance_traits: Gray coveralls, rolled sleeves, steady hands.
char_levi_002.behavior_under_pressure: Fixes the object in front of him and asks the direct question once.
contradictions: Stays calm in the room while pressing the hardest question.
char_levi_002.emotional_wound: He learned about the family stall's closure from a sign on the door.
fears: Being the last to know again
habits: Squares the ledger to the table edge before speaking.
char_levi_002.identity_summary: The quieter partner who reads the numbers and refuses vague reassurance.
char_levi_002.mistaken_belief: Patience alone can carry a partner past a hidden cost.

relationships.dependency: He needs her honesty more than her certainty.
relationships.present_tension: He needs the warning she withheld.

relevant_background_history: Kept the cooperative's books from the first week.
Watched his sister hide one bad total before and stayed anyway.
char_levi_002.social_context: The team treats him as the calm next step after bad news.

voice.rhythm: Measured, one question at a time.

wants.external: Reconcile the ledger before payroll clears.
wants.internal: Be treated as a partner, not a problem to shield.

char_mara_001.appearance_traits: Short natural curls, alert eyes, compact work-ready posture.
char_mara_001.behavior_under_pressure: Takes on physical work and conceals paperwork until forced.
contradictions: Demands clear estimates while hiding the warning from her own partner.
char_mara_001.emotional_wound: She was the last person told that her father's stall was closing.
habits: Straightens tools when avoiding a question.
char_mara_001.identity_summary: A repair-cooperative owner who fixes motors faster than she admits mistakes.
char_mara_001.mistaken_belief: A good leader protects everyone by solving problems alone.

relationships.dependency: She trusts his judgment but fears his disappointment.
relationships.present_tension: She withheld a payment warning he needs.

relevant_background_history: Helped her father close his repair stall after an avoidable cash crisis.
Built the cooperative with her brother Levi and promised no more surprises.
char_mara_001.social_context: Responsible for a small team that trusts her with its livelihoods.

voice.restraint: Admits the fact before naming the feeling.

wants.external: Keep the cooperative open and pay the team.

cast.choice_or_consequence: Disclosure shifts her from isolation to shared responsibility.
cast.immediate_story_function: Must choose to expose the hidden warning.

cast.choice_or_consequence: His restrained offer makes Mara's turn possible.
cast.immediate_story_function: Refuses vague reassurance and shows the empty ledger.

episode_world.continuity_rules: Notice sealed before admission, open afterward; ledger stays on the table.

episode_world.light_color_atmosphere: Warm overhead work lights; cool fading daylight from the door.

episode_world.sound_environment: Distant workshop fan; quiet room tone once it stops.
episode_world.wardrobe_intent: Practical workshop clothing with clear silhouettes.

claim_map.assertion: A fourteen-day cash-flow review surfaces a shortfall before payroll.

owner_answers.assertion: We run a fourteen-day cash-flow review before every payroll.
owner_answers.question: What routine catches a shortfall early?

premise.blocks: The ledger cannot be reconciled without the notice she hid.
premise.consequence: Payroll clears tomorrow whether or not the partners agree.
premise.likely_change: A shared weekly ledger turns concealment into a repair plan.
premise.who_wants_what: Mara wants to protect the cooperative without admitting the shortfall.
